concepts.description: A modular architectural unit that encapsulates the AUV system components.
A physical or simulated robotic platform that interacts with sensors and actuators within the AUV system.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data.
A component within the AUV module responsible for managing and directing system behaviour.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module to represent fundamental value kinds.
A structured data type defined within the AUV module that groups multiple named values of possibly different types.
A named data field within a composite type that holds a specific type of data.
A signal or trigger defined within an interface that can be invoked to perform an action or request information.
A callable unit defined within the AUV module that takes inputs and returns a computed output.

instances.description: The top-level module representing the AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces defined by AUV_Module.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuator outputs.
The controller responsible for operator-level control of the AUV, using the Inputs interface.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
The Last Response Engine controller within AUV_Module, using Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl to send output commands.
The autopilot controller within AUV_Module, using the Outputs interface to issue navigation commands.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values (true or false).
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A Spherical Vector composite type recording radial, polar, and azimuth values all of type real.
A value of type real representing the radial component of the SVec composite type.
A value of type real representing the polar component of the SVec composite type.
A value of type real representing the azimuth component of the SVec composite type.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id (all of type real), and obs_hdng (of type SVec).
A value of type real representing the north-south relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type real representing the east-west relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type real representing the depth in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type real representing the identifier in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type SVec representing the obstacle heading in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type SVec representing the heading sensor reading in the Sensors interface.
A value of type Obstacle representing the obstacle sensor reading in the Sensors interface.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, used to signal the end of a task.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, used to request an OCM operation.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, used to request a MOM operation.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, used to request an HCM operation.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, used to request the current velocity.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, used to request the current heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, used to advise a velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, used to advise a heading.
A composite type recording horiz_cda and vert_cda (of type real) and id (of type nat), representing close proximity data.
A value of type real representing the horizontal close distance allowance in the Close composite type.
A value of type real representing the vertical close distance allowance in the Close composite type.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
